content.title: Aramark (NYSE:ARMK) Misses Q3 CY2025 Sales Expectations
content.summary: Food and facilities services provider Aramark (NYSE:ARMK) missed Wall Street’s revenue expectations in Q3 CY2025, but sales rose 14.3% year on year to $5.05 billion. On the other hand, the company’s outlook for the full year was close to analysts’ estimates with revenue guided to $19.75 billion at the midpoint. Its GAAP profit of $0.33 per share was 44.7% below analysts’ consensus estimates.
